title: ieee1905: Remove Category from Proxied Encap DPP
description:
Revert changes from 43d2655f16ab70e97d35700f628e23720c8e58db

The previous change in 43d2655f16 was based on a misinterpretation of
the spec. The Category field from the corresponding 802.11 Action Frame
is not supposed to be part of the encapsulated data. According to the
spec, Category determines the DPP Frame Indicator field (bit 5 of
flags).

Wi-Fi EasyMesh Specification Version 6.0 - Section 5.3.4.1
